question: As of November 7, 2024, what were Cloudflare management's lower and upper Q4 2024 revenue guidance endpoints in USD millions? Identify them as forecasts and cite the release and call transcript.

answer.answer: As of the November 7, 2024 Q3 2024 earnings release and call, Cloudflare management guided Q4 2024 (fourth quarter of fiscal 2024) total revenue to a range of $451.0 million to $452.0 million — a forecast, not an actual result. The press release's "Financial Outlook" section states "Total revenue of $451.0 to $452.0 million," and CFO Thomas Seifert repeated on the call, "For the fourth quarter, we expect revenue in the range of $451 million to $452 million."

2024-11-07
Third quarter revenue totaled $430.1 million, representing an increase of 28% year-over-year

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET), the leading connectivity cloud company, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2024.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: "I am pleased with our results for the third quarter—exceeding expectations for revenue, operating margin, and free cash flow while also reaching a key inflection point in the transformation of our go-to-market organization. In addition, we added a record 219 large customers and achieved a new milestone—35% of the Fortune 500 are now paying Cloudflare customers,” said Matthew Prince, co-founder & CEO of Cloudflare. “I’m also proud of what we did to support causes even bigger than ourselves—helping to ensure cyber attacks did not play a role in impacting the outcome of the United States 2024 election. We exceeded financial, customer, and innovation milestones, all while protecting both presidential candidates and providing our services, at no cost, to hundreds of government websites in more than half of U.S. states. I want to thank our team for coming to the aid of election officials and campaigns whenever they had a need and for playing a vital role in upholding the democratic process."

Non-GAAP income from operations was $63.5 million, or 14.8% of revenue, compared to $42.5 million, or 12.7% of revenue, in the third quarter of 2023.

Non-GAAP net income per diluted share was $0.20, compared to $0.16 in the third quarter of 2023.

lines.text: Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET) is the leading connectivity cloud company on a mission to help build a better Internet. It empowers organizations to make their employees, applications and networks faster and more secure everywhere, while reducing complexity and cost. Cloudflare’s connectivity cloud delivers the most full-featured, unified platform of cloud-native products and developer tools, so any organization can gain the control they need to work, develop, and accelerate their business.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Powered by one of the world’s largest and most interconnected networks, Cloudflare blocks billions of threats online for its customers every day. It is trusted by millions of organizations – from the largest brands to entrepreneurs and small businesses to nonprofits, humanitarian groups, and governments across the globe.

2024-11-07
Third quarter revenue totaled $430.1 million, representing an increase of 28% year-over-year
GAAP loss from operations of $30.8 million, or 7% of revenue, and non-GAAP income from operations of $63.5 million, or 15% of revenue

SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET), the leading connectivity cloud company, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2024.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET), the leading connectivity cloud company, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2024.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: "I am pleased with our results for the third quarter—exceeding expectations for revenue, operating margin, and free cash flow while also reaching a key inflection point in the transformation of our go-to-market organization. In addition, we added a record 219 large customers and achieved a new milestone—35% of the Fortune 500 are now paying Cloudflare customers,” said Matthew Prince, co-founder & CEO of Cloudflare. “I’m also proud of what we did to support causes even bigger than ourselves—helping to ensure cyber attacks did not play a role in impacting the outcome of the United States 2024 election. We exceeded financial, customer, and innovation milestones, all while protecting both presidential candidates and providing our services, at no cost, to hundreds of government websites in more than half of U.S. states. I want to thank our team for coming to the aid of election officials and campaigns whenever they had a need and for playing a vital role in upholding the democratic process."

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Third Quarter Fiscal 2024 Financial Highlights

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Revenue : Total revenue of $430.1 million, representing an increase of 28% year-over-year.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Gross Profit : GAAP gross profit was $334.1 million, or 77.7% gross margin, compared to $257.5 million, or 76.7%, in the third quarter of 2023. Non-GAAP gross profit was $339.1 million, or 78.8% gross margin, compared to $264.2 million, or 78.7%, in the third quarter of 2023.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Operating Income (Loss) : GAAP loss from operations was $30.8 million, or 7.2% of revenue, compared to $39.2 million, or 11.7% of revenue, in the third quarter of 2023. Non-GAAP income from operations was $63.5 million, or 14.8% of revenue, compared to $42.5 million, or 12.7% of revenue, in the third quarter of 2023.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Net Income (Loss) : GAAP net loss was $15.3 million, compared to $23.5 million in the third quarter of 2023. GAAP net loss per basic and diluted share was $0.04, compared to $0.07 in the third quarter of 2023. Non-GAAP net income was $72.6 million, compared to $55.3 million in the third quarter of 2023. Non-GAAP net income per diluted share was $0.20, compared to $0.16 in the third quarter of 2023.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Cash Flow : Net cash flow from operating activities was $104.7 million, compared to $68.1 million for the third quarter of 2023. Free cash flow was $45.3 million, or 11% of revenue, compared to $34.9 million, or 10% of revenue, in the third quarter of 2023.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: Cash, cash equivalents, and available-for-sale securities were $1,823.8 million as of September 30, 2024.

original_location.section: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2024 Financial Results

lines.text: For the full year fiscal 2024, we expect:
